Print & Editorial

Queen Anne Menus

Project Overview

The launch of Cunard's Queen Anne introduced new dining concepts across the ship. I designed the menus for Aranya and Tramonto, shaping their distinct identities: Aranya's bold contemporary elegance and Tramonto's warm Mediterranean character. Both contribute to a cohesive, modern expression of 
Cunard's luxury and heritage.

Aranya
Tramonto

The challenge

  • Bespoke illustrations required
  • Compressed timelines due to Queen Anne's launch
  • Multiple stakeholders with shifting feedbacks
  • Large volumes of detailed information that needed
    precise hierarchy, spacing, and readability

Outcome

  • Developed distinct venue identities while
    preserving overall brand cohesion
  • The Aranya cover was selected for the Cunarder
    magazine cover and received exceptional feedback
  • Enhanced the perception of the Cunard Difference
